headline: NiziU unveil 2nd MV teaser for holiday song 'Jolly Jolly'
sub: Their first-ever holiday song lands on their Japan debut anniversary
source: Source: JYP Entertainment official YouTube, via Korean media
caption:
NiziU have dropped a second music video teaser for 'Jolly Jolly', their first-ever holiday song.

The digital single and MV arrive Dec 2 at midnight JST — exactly six years after the group's Japanese debut. The track will also feature on their 3rd EP 'You're the best', out March 17, 2027.
